query:
SELECT 
  l.id, l.name, l.type, l.origin, l.notes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lpm.plant_id) AS plant_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lmm.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM laboratoire l
LEFT JOIN laboratoire_plant_molecules lpm ON lpm.laboratoire_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN laboratoire_molecule_molecules lmm ON lmm.laboratoire_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.type, l.origin, l.notes
ORDER BY l.type, l.name
LIMIT 30;
